title: With Willie Bryant: Ubangi Club and a definite downbeat
summary: Thomas went back to New York with Willie Bryant, playing the Ubangi Club and Savoy for about a year. He calls Bryant a great show conductor with a clear downbeat, unlike Lucky Millinder.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: What did you do then when you left?
I joined Willy Bryant's band.
Oh, you went back to New York?
JT (1 of 2)
Yes ... Smack was going to California and the money wasn't that good anyhow so I come back to New York to get with ...
To make your fame and fortune.
Get my money together, you know.
Well, was Willie at the Savoy then?
No, Willie was at the Ubangi Club. He might have been at the Savoy, too. He had two gigs between the Savoy and the Ubangi but the job we were going was the Ubangi.
A very good band, may I say.

I heard him at the Savoy. He had Sidney DeParis in that band I remember but I don't think you were in there. I wonder where you were in '37. See, this is what we said that I never heard you in person so I must have been missing you somehow.
Well, maybe you didn't look for me. I was right there in '37 with Willy Bryant's band. Oh, yeah, the Savoy, too.
No, but when you joined Willie, Willie was at the Ubangi.
Yeah, that's right. You're right.
How long were you with Willy?
BT: You didn't.
About a year I guess. Willy Bryant had an idea without he knew where the imposing on you ... downbeat was ...
He wasn't a musician?
JT (1 of 2)
He was possibly the greatest conductor I ever worked with.
Really? Is that so?
Yeah, he was. For shows.
It's extraordinary, too. Lucky Millinder was supposed to be quite clever in his way.

Well, Lucky was xx flamboyant. I did a show with Lucky xx at the Apollo. Lucky was flamboyant. He waved because he didn't know where the downbeat was coming. I won't say who was better. I wouldn't say that. But, for a trumpet, anybody has got to start to see where the down beat was and Willy, I liked them both. But, Willy, you know where the downbeat was, here it is.
It was definite.
It was very definite.
